info.name: Pneuma - information brought to life
info.description: REST API collection for Pneuma. Set the baseUrl variable, run 'Login' to capture a token, then call the rest.

item.name: Create Model Runner (with retry and concurrency limits)

request.description: Create a model endpoint. maxConcurrentRequests caps requests in flight to it across ingestion and chat (requests beyond it wait); maxRetries is how many times a transient failure (408, 429, 502, 503, 504) is retried with jittered backoff that honors Retry-After. Secrets such as apiKey are write-only. maxInputTokens is the largest embedding input in the model's tokens (0 uses the known limit for the model family); chunks are sized to fit it.

item.name: Model Endpoint Health (all, dedup by base URL)
Run Health Check Now
item.description: Run a single health probe against the endpoint immediately (no request body). 200 returns the endpoint health object (same shape as 'Model Endpoint Health (by id)'). 400 if health checks are disabled for the endpoint; 404 if the endpoint is not found.

item.name: Create Model Endpoint
item.description: Managed natively by Pneuma (no external proxy). type = Embedding|Completion; provider selects the PolyPrompt provider (OpenAI, OpenAICompatible, Gemini, Ollama, AzureOpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, VoyageAI, VertexAI) and determines which provider-specific fields apply (deployment/apiVersion for AzureOpenAI, region/accessKeyId for Bedrock, project/region for VertexAI). Secrets (apiKey, secretAccessKey, sessionToken) are write-only and never returned on read.

exec: var d = pm.response.json(); if (d && (d.id || d.Id)) pm.collectionVariables.set('completionEndpointId', d.id || d.Id);

body.raw:
{
  "type": "Completion",
  "provider": "Ollama",
  "name": "local-chat",
  "model": "llama3.2",
  "endpoint": "http://ollama:11434",
  "apiFormat": "Ollama",
  "deployment": null,
  "apiVersion": null,
  "region": null,
  "project": null,
  "accessKeyId": null,
  "apiKey": null,
  "secretAccessKey": null,
  "sessionToken": null,
  "active": true,
  "maxConcurrentRequests": 2,
  "maxQueueDepth": 0,
  "contextSize": 8192
}

item.name: Update Model Endpoint
item.description: Update an endpoint by id. Include provider + provider-specific fields; leave a secret field null/omitted to keep the stored value. Example shows an Azure OpenAI completion endpoint.

{
  "type": "Completion",
  "provider": "AzureOpenAI",
  "name": "azure-chat",
  "model": "gpt-4o",
  "endpoint": "https://my-resource.openai.azure.com",

  "apiVersion": "2024-02-15-preview",
  "region": null,
  "project": null,
  "accessKeyId": null,

  "sessionToken": null,
  "active": true,

}

item.name: Update Settings
item.description: GET /v1.0/settings first, edit the returned 'settings' object, and PUT it back here. Leave secret fields as '********' to keep the stored value.

item.name: Get Ingestion Settings
item.description: Read the dashboard-tunable ingestion concurrency (IngestionTuning): per-stage caps plus the job pool, summarization, and timeout knobs. Admin-only.

item.name: Update Ingestion Settings
item.description: Persist and apply (live, no restart) the ingestion concurrency defaults. GET /v1.0/settings/ingestion first, then edit and PUT the same shape.

exec: var d = pm.response.json(); if (d && (d.id || d.Id)) pm.collectionVariables.set('collectionId', d.id || d.Id);

item.name: Create Subject
item.description: Optionally include a nullable-per-field `concurrencyOverrides` object (same keys as PUT /v1.0/settings/ingestion) to override ingestion concurrency for this subject; omitted/null fields inherit the system default. See the Update Subject example.

exec: var d = pm.response.json(); if (d && d.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('subjectId', d.id);

body.raw:
{
  "displayName": "Example Subject",
  "type": "Topic",
  "description": "A demonstration subject for the API examples.",
  "tagline": "Ask about Example Subject. Answers are grounded in the archive, with sources.",
  "embeddingModel": "{{embeddingEndpointId}}",
  "inferenceModel": "{{completionEndpointId}}",
  "collection": "{{collectionId}}",
  "rerankingModel": null,
  "promptRewriteModel": null
}

item.name: Submit Link
item.description: The embedding/inference models and collection are taken from the subject (configure them on the subject first). Optional labels (strings) and tags (key/value) are attached to every chunk this link produces and to its source graph node, so retrieval can later be scoped to them via a query/chat metadataFilter.

request.description: Negative example: a URL whose host is a private IP literal or localhost is refused by the fetch-safety policy with 400 and a FetchBlocked audit record. Allow the host in Ingestion.FetchSafety.AllowedPrivateHosts to ingest it.
Negative example: only http and https URLs can be ingested; file, ftp, and other schemes return 400.

item.name: Reingest Link
item.description: Queues a fresh ingestion job that forces a full re-run of this link. The link's content hash is cleared first so the delta-skip can't short-circuit the pipeline. Returns 202 Accepted with the created job.

request.description: Queue a fresh ingestion job for the link (202). The previous version stays searchable until the new job has indexed the new content; then the earlier chunks and Source and Cell graph nodes are removed and the link's currentJobId moves to the new job.

exec: pm.test('a new job is returned', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().id).to.match(/^job_/); });

item.name: Reingest Links (bulk)
item.description: Queues a fresh ingestion job per link (each forces a full re-run). Returns 202 Accepted with { queued, skipped }.

item.name: Set Link Refresh Schedule
item.description: Set how often Pneuma re-checks this URL link for changes: refreshIntervalMinutes 0 (off) or 60 to 525600, or useSubjectDefault. Returns the link with its nextRefreshUtc. 400 for pushed content, crawled links, or an invalid interval.

item.name: Set Link Refresh Schedule (bulk)
item.description: Set the refresh schedule of several links. Returns { updated, skipped } where skipped lists ids that are unknown or cannot be refreshed.

item.name: Check Link for Changes Now
item.description: Conditional GET of the link now. outcome is Unchanged, Queued (a re-ingest job with trigger Refresh was queued), Busy, or Failed (the current version is kept and the check backs off).

request.description: List ingestion jobs, newest first. Optional filters: status (Queued, Processing, Completed, Failed, Cancelled), failureCategory (why a job failed, for example Fetch or ModelUnavailable), and hasWarnings (true or false). Leave a filter empty to ignore it.
Failed jobs whose source could not be fetched. Change failureCategory to any category in REST_API.md.
Jobs that completed but dropped some work (a failed classification batch, summary, or cell node). Each job lists its warnings.
Negative example: an unknown failureCategory returns 400 BadRequest.
Job detail: the job (with failureCategory, warnings, and completeness), its stage events, every attempt, and remediation for its failure category.

item.name: List Subject Prompts
item.description: Effective prompts for the subject: each { key, name, effectiveContent, globalContent, overrideContent|null, source (Global|SubjectOverride), mergeMode (Append|Replace) }.

item.name: Set Subject Prompt Override
item.description: Set (or clear) the subject's override for a prompt key. mergeMode Append layers the override after the global prompt; Replace uses the override alone. Empty content clears the override (falls back to global).

item.name: Delete Subject Prompt Override
item.description: Remove the subject's override for a prompt key (falls back to the global prompt). Returns 204.

item.name: Inline content

request.description: Push Markdown into a subject. Returns 201 with the inline link and the queued job id. The declared contentType replaces type detection.
Push a JSON document; it is extracted through DocumentAtom's JSON route.
Push content with an externalKey. Sending it again with the same key replaces the content (200, replaced: true) instead of adding a duplicate.
Push several items at once (at most 100). The third item has an unsupported contentType and is reported as rejected; the others are created.
Negative example: contentType must be text/plain, text/markdown, text/html, or application/json.

item.description: Push text, Markdown, HTML, or JSON into a subject without a URL. Content is stored and ingested like a link; an externalKey makes a push an upsert.

item.name: Crawl plans

request.description: The crawler types this server supports, each with its settings schema (fields, kinds, ranges, options, defaults, and which are secrets).

Create a plan that crawls a site into the subject nightly at 03:00 UTC. Returns 201 with the plan; save its id as crawlPlanId. 400 for invalid settings or schedule, 404 for an unknown subject, 400 when the subject has no models or collection.
Create a daily S3 plan with deletions on. The secretKey is stored encrypted and never returned; the response lists it in secretsSet.
Create a plan that ingests the URLs in a site's sitemaps (a robots.txt URL is read for its Sitemap lines). lastmod is the version, so unchanged pages are not re-read.
Create a plan over an SMB share. The password is stored encrypted and never returned. When Pneuma runs in a container, host localhost means the host machine.
Create a plan over an NFSv3 export (AUTH_SYS). mountPort is the server's mountd port (20048 on most Linux servers).

Create a plan over a GitHub repository's default branch, limited to the docs folder. The token is optional (needed for private repositories and a higher rate limit), stored encrypted, and never returned.
Create a plan over an Azure Blob container. Leave endpoint empty for https://{account}.blob.core.windows.net/.
Create a plan over a Google Cloud Storage bucket. jsonCredentials is the service account key file contents, stored encrypted and never returned.
Create a plan over a folder on the Pneuma server. Available only when Crawling.AllowedLocalRoots lists a root containing the folder; otherwise 400.
List crawl plans (add subjectId= to scope to a subject).
List one subject's crawl plans.
Read a plan. Secret values are never returned.
Replace the configuration. Secrets left out keep their stored values; names in clearSecrets are removed. The type cannot change (400).
Test a draft plan's connection without saving anything. Add ?fromPlanId= to fill empty secrets from a stored plan while editing it.
Test the stored plan's connection step by step; each layer says what was checked and what to fix.
What a run would add, update, retry, delete, and skip right now. Nothing is changed. 502 when the source cannot be listed.
Start an operation now. 202 with the operation (save its id as crawlOperationId); 409 when the plan is already running.
Stop the running operation; queued ingestion jobs are cancelled. 409 when the plan is idle.
The plan's operations, newest first.
Objects the plan tracks, optionally by status (Active, Missing, Failed, Excluded).
Delete the plan. With deleteLinks=true its links are deleted too; otherwise they are kept and detached. 409 while running.
Negative example: an invalid cron expression is rejected with 400.
Negative example: intervals shorter than 5 minutes are rejected with 400.

item.name: Create Web crawl plan (robots off, admin only)

request.description: Negative example for non-administrators: turning robots.txt off requires a system or tenant administrator (403 otherwise) and is audited.

item.description: Keep a subject in sync with a web site, sitemap, S3 bucket, or CIFS or NFS share. Secret settings (passwords, keys, tokens) are write-only: they are stored encrypted, never returned, and redacted from request history; secretsSet names the ones stored. Deletions are off by default, and a run that would delete more than maxDeletionFraction of the plan's links is held for confirmation.

item.name: Crawl operations

request.description: Operations, newest first; filter by planId and status (Running, Ingesting, Succeeded, PartiallySucceeded, Failed, Cancelled, Held).
One operation with its counts and error.
What the operation did with each object; filter by action (Add, Update, Retry, Delete, Skip, Fail).
Run the deletions a Held operation is waiting on. 409 when the operation is not Held.

item.description: Runs of crawl plans: counts, per-object results, and confirmation of held deletions.
